elements.description: Text that arrives piece by piece out of a soft blur when it scrolls into view.

properties.name: by
properties.description: Reveal word by word or letter by letter

properties.name: stagger
properties.description: Time between two pieces, in ms

properties.name: delay
properties.description: Wait before the first piece, in ms

properties.name: duration
properties.description: Time each piece takes to arrive, in ms

properties.name: as
properties.description: What the text is: a paragraph, a heading (h1–h3, the host becomes a heading of that level) or inline text

properties.name: once
properties.description: Reveal only the first time; false plays it again each time it enters the view (attribute: once="false")

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"
